clips.title: The story
paras: Cenarion Lunardust is a sacred powder bestowed upon young tauren druids by Turak Runetotem on the heights of Thunder Bluff. It is used to awaken the guardian beast Lunaclaw at an ancient Moonkin Stone on the border of Mulgore and the Barrens.

Entrusted to initiates ready to claim their place among the Druids of the Claw, Cenarion Lunardust carries the blessings of the Cenarion Circle. When scattered across the Moonkin Stone west of Camp Taurajo, the glowing dust summons forth Lunaclaw, a sacred beast bound to test the initiate. Defeating this guardian tests both physical fortitude and spiritual resolve, allowing the young druid to absorb the strength of body and heart required to assume the form of the bear.
